description: Directorate-General for Communication: transport datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Directorate-General for Communication, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Directorate-General for Communication. Coverage: Directorate-General for Communication. The listing groups 5 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about transport; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Flash Eurobarometer 301: Road Safety in Europe; Special Eurobarometer 400: Attitudes of Europeans towards the use of r; Special Eurobarometer 422a: Quality of transport / Special Eurobaromet; Special Eurobarometer SP527 : Fairness perceptions of the green transi. Formats seen: ZIP, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, European Commission reuse notice. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-commu.
